architecture.approach: Organizer pages are Next.js client components. Creation uses react-hook-form + Zod and submits to events.createEvent, which owns free/Pro rules, slug generation, and rate limiting. Images upload to Convex storage. The dashboard reads Convex stats and registrations; check-in scans with html5-qrcode and calls registrations.checkInAttendee.

components.name: app/(main)/create-event/page.tsx
components.description: Create-event form, date/time combining, Pro prompts, submission.

components.name: components/ImagePicker.tsx
components.description: Uploads a file to Convex storage or selects a URL.

components.description: Clerk checkout prompt for Pro limits.

dataModel.flowDescription: Organizer submits the validated form; createEvent checks the free limit and Pro flag, writes the event with a timestamped slug, and increments freeEventsCreated. The dashboard reads stats and registrations. Check-in resolves a QR code to a registration, verifies the organizer, and records checkedIn/checkedInAt once.

securityConsiderations.description: Dashboard, attendee list, delete, and check-in compare event.organizerId with the authenticated user id inside Convex.
createEvent uses a 3/minute token bucket and checkInAttendee a 10/minute token bucket keyed by user id.

performanceConsiderations.strategy: Queries use by_organizer and by_event indexes; attendee filtering runs client-side over one event's list.

risks.description: The free-event counter and delete reclaim rule are not symmetric.
risks.mitigation: Confirm the intended rule and align create/delete accounting before changing the feature.

risks.description: Revenue is estimated from confirmed tickets while payment is offline.
risks.mitigation: Keep the estimate labelled and out of reconciliation.
